First, the player must find mossy_stone_bricks as a landmark/navigation task that leads them to the area where stone is available. Then, mining stone serves as a basic resource-gathering step that demonstrates the player can mine. However, to mine packed_ice efficiently, the player needs a pickaxe — specifically, we require them to craft a golden_pickaxe (gold ingots will be provided in the scene). The golden_pickaxe then enables mining packed_ice, which requires a pickaxe tool. This creates a branching dependency: finding mossy_stone_bricks leads to mining stone (proving location awareness), while crafting the golden_pickaxe (from provided materials) is needed before mining packed_ice. The chain tests navigation, crafting, and tool-use in sequence.

Uses inventory_has for cobblestone because stone blocks drop cobblestone when mined (not stone itself, unless Silk Touch is used). The player mines stone blocks placed at ~3-5, 0-1, 7-8 and receives cobblestone in their inventory. This is the standard 'mine' task verification — the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden pickaxe places it directly into the player's inventory. The player uses 3 gold ingots and 2 sticks from the chest with the crafting table to produce a golden pickaxe. The item was not in the starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful crafting.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='block' because packed ice drops NOTHING when mined without Silk Touch — it simply disappears. Therefore inventory_has cannot be used. Instead, we verify that at least one packed ice block has been removed from the formation (originally 27 blocks in a 3x3x3 area at ~14-16, 0-2, 3-5). A generous box (±2 around the formation) checks that the packed ice count is at most 26, confirming at least one block was mined/broken.

task_text: Find the mossy stone brick structure, mine some stone blocks nearby, use the gold ingots and sticks from the chest with the crafting table to craft a golden pickaxe, then mine the packed ice blocks.
design_notes: Layout flows left-to-right from spawn: mossy bricks (landmark) → stone (behind) → crafting area (side) → packed ice (far). Dependencies are spatial/sequential. IMPORTANT MECHANICS: (1) Stone drops cobblestone when mined - milestones must check cobblestone in inventory or mine_block counter. (2) Packed ice drops NOTHING without Silk Touch - must use mine_block counter or voxel_count decrease. (3) Golden pickaxe has mining level 0 (same as wooden) - dependency on crafting it before mining packed ice is spatial ordering, not mechanical requirement.
